newsitem.title: UK: Ghana weekly purchases by Jan 9 overtake 1995/96.
newsitem.headline: Ghana weekly purchases by Jan 9 overtake 1995/96.

text.p: Ghana cocoa purchases in the 13th week of the 1996/97 season ending January 9 were 16,364 tonnes compared with 8,950 tonnes in the week ending January 11, 1996, the Ghana Cocoa Board said on Wednesday.
Cumulative purchases were 229,754 tonnes against 287,266 in the same period of 1995/96 which corresponded with the 14th week of the season.
Purchases in the 13th week of the last season were 10,548 tonnes with the cumulative at 278,316 tonnes by January 4. -- Clelia Oziel, London Newsroom 44-171-542 8072
